title: Ranking of Kings: The Treasure Chest of Courage
native: 王様ランキング 勇気の宝箱
synopsis:
Get ready for a new collection of stories from Ranking of Kings!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
search_text: ranking of kings the treasure chest of courage 王様ランキンク 勇気の宝箱 tv finished

episodes.title: Kage's Errand | The Prince and Money
episodes.synopsis: When Bojji's training schedule is interrupted, Kage is sent shopping for the item that Despa needs to keep going. Despa sends Bojji and Kage out to earn some money, claiming that Bojji is too naïve about society to be a king, and could use some exposure. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Beasts of the Wilderness | A Mysterious Desert
episodes.synopsis: Bojji and Kage camp for the night in the desert with the Order of the Underworld, where they must deal with the threat of wild beasts. Following a sandstorm, the group finds a secluded oasis, and encounter creatures the Order has never seen before. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Hiling's Old Friend | Daida and Magic
episodes.synopsis: After being thrown out of the kingdom, Hiling insists on enlisting Ann's aid to return and save Daida, but other matters keep Ann from joining her. A young Daida wants to learn how his mother is able to heal others, but finds it a tough skill to master. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Immortality and the Three Brothers
episodes.synopsis: Ouken's past is revealed as his desire to become stronger and put an end to his father's cruel reign is recounted. Over the course of the hard-fought war against the Gigantes, the prince distinguishes himself by his conduct, until one fateful day. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Law of the Underworld | A White Horse in Love | The Gentle Soldier, Hokuro
episodes.synopsis: Fren is branded an outlaw when he leaves the underworld to help save Ouken. When Whiteking grows fat after the captain neglects to care for her, only one thing can whip her back into shape. Hokuro joins the military to repay Bojji's kindness. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Bojji the King | The Melancholy of King Daida
episodes.synopsis: Bojji, Bebin, and Hokuro conduct a royal inspection of the town, during which Bojji insists on helping some children find their lost bird. After Daida becomes king again, he tries his hardest to live up to Bojji's example in leading the kingdom. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Snake Charmer with the Crooked Smile | The Big Four's Banquet
Kage's Yearning | A Great Mother
episodes.synopsis: A young Kage is afraid of the world around him, but finds his courage when faced with a dangerous encounter. Shiina seeks for more strength, but comes to realize that the greatest strength of all is not directed inward, but is found when helping others. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Miranjo and the Demon | The Prince and His Treasures
episodes.synopsis: Young Miranjo happens upon a child demon while playing in the forest, and lands in trouble when she can't find her way home. As Bojji prepares to leave the castle to look for Kage, he pauses to give gifts to those who have helped him get where he is. (Source: Crunchyroll)
